aiReadyLines.text: Unit Six : Leisure 57
Lesson 2: Leisure
Keywords: stare, streams
Read aloud and recite the poem.
What is this life if, full of care,
We have no time to stand and stare.
No time to stand beneath the boughs,
And stare as long as sheep or cows.
No time to see, when woods we pass,
Where squirrels hide their nuts in grass.
No time to see, in broad day light,
Streams full of stars, like skies at night.
A poor life this is if, full of care,
We have no time to stand and stare.
[William Henry Davies]
Make a list of the beautiful things the poet talks about in the poem.
Read the poem, discuss in groups/pairs and write answers to
these questions:
Why does the poet think that we have no time to stand and stare?
Do you think people often do not have time to enjoy the beauty of nature?

1. Why does the poet think that we have no time to stand and stare?
